newsitem.title: USA: Palomar gets FDA nod for laser treatment.
newsitem.headline: Palomar gets FDA nod for laser treatment.

text.p: Palomar Medical Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it received additional clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to sell its Tru-Pulse(TM) C02 laser for the treatment of wrinkles, scar revision and burn debridement.

The laser system had previously received FDA clearance for skin resurfacing, and has been marketed since May, 1996. The current FDA clearance enables Palomar to specifically market this laser for the treatment of wrinkles, scar revision and burn debridement, which is the removal of dead or contaminated tissue.
Palomar supplies proprietary laser systems for dermatological and cosmetic laser treatment, and makes and sells specialty electronic products.
